working_tree_semantics: Round 4 was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. Existing user changes were preserved. No files were staged, committed, or pushed.

authority_contract.run_permission_truth: immutable permission snapshot columns on every admitted turn and queued prompt
authority_contract.plan_overlay: PLAN_READ_ONLY is a narrowing-only ROOT admission overlay
authority_contract.automatic_continuation_owner: Host process-local ContinuationAdmissionAttempt owns write, query-first ACK confirmation, ROOT slot settlement, and task bind
authority_contract.question_wait_owner: pre-write dormant process-local waiter; human wait has no physical-operation deadline
authority_contract.canonical_reader_cut: one repeatable-read composite containing conversation, run permission, workflow, handoff, and approved-plan facts
authority_contract.approved_plan_materialization: closed PIN_EXISTING_CANONICAL_BLOCK or MATERIALIZE_REFERENCED_BLOCK exact-once identity join
authority_contract.rejected_plan_batch: INVALID_ARGUMENTS or TOOL_UNAVAILABLE is accepted as POLICY_NO_ATTEMPT; every sibling is atomically CANCELLED_BEFORE_DISPATCH; the origin turn remains RUNNING and ACK loss confirms the stable winner without physical redispatch

protocol_contract.draft_feedback: presence-bearing optional field; missing and present-empty REVISE normalize to NO_FEEDBACK
protocol_contract.stable_winner: commit-time handoff_created_at_commit only; mutable disposition is read through canonical control
protocol_contract.go_scope: minimal permission selector and Plan question/review/decision state; Python remains authority

real_provider_dogfood.configuration: one configured OpenAI-compatible chat-completions provider; MCP discovery replaced by an empty tuple only inside the dogfood process; user configuration was not modified
real_provider_dogfood.database: fresh clean-v0 ephemeral database, force-dropped after verification

main_flow.sequence: enter -> read-only write denial -> question -> answer -> draft -> revise -> revised draft -> approve -> implementation

post_dogfood_batch_barrier_closure.resolution: the frozen Plan call now owns a closed APPLY, INVALID_ARGUMENTS, or TOOL_UNAVAILABLE candidate; rejected calls and all siblings are accepted atomically as no-attempt results and exact winner confirmation covers simulated post-COMMIT ACK loss

post_activation_root_ownership_closure.all_root_producers: direct submission, queue delivery, Plan review successor, Terminal observation, and external result all install the single Host-owned accepted ROOT chain
post_activation_root_ownership_closure.detached_waiter: API or gateway cancellation detaches from an asyncio shield; the ROOT task owns exact slot settlement and wakes pending producers when its complete continuation lineage exits
post_activation_root_ownership_closure.force_exit_race: the Plan exit fence and origin-task liveness are checked at automatic-continuation bind; an admitted FULL winner that loses the race is deterministically interrupted before the fence is released
post_activation_root_ownership_closure.plan_content_capability: Python Protocol v3 binds Plan resolution and exact content reads to the current controller attachment ID in addition to the existing attachment ID/generation request gate

post_review_plan_resolution_and_force_ex.semantic_attempt_identity: question answer, draft decision, and normalized feedback are covered by the central semantic candidate fingerprint; the same process-local attempt ID only shares an exact fingerprint and otherwise conflicts before repository write
post_review_plan_resolution_and_force_ex.force_exit_phase_one: the exact workflow ID, revision, Host ROOT identity, canonical running ROOT turn, and open interaction are validated and terminalized in one Host-writer transaction before physical task cancellation
post_review_plan_resolution_and_force_ex.resolution_fence: an exact command winner remains queryable, while every new QUESTION, APPROVE, REVISE, or CANCEL write is linearized under the Host lock and rejected after the force-exit fence is installed
post_review_plan_resolution_and_force_ex.unbound_successor_terminalization: the admitting attempt transitions to a process-local TERMINALIZING substate and uses fresh bounded repository cycles until the exact successor is terminal or explicitly owned by a replacement writer
post_review_plan_resolution_and_force_ex.python_option_ordinal: both the Python DTO and repository selection require a non-negative in-range ordinal
regression_evidence: three same-command semantic conflict matrices do not share the first task
stale force-exit leaves the valid ROOT provider task live and completes normally
all four Plan resolution branches are rejected behind the force-exit fence without repository writes
an injected first terminalization failure is retried and the FULL successor is confirmed INTERRUPTED before attempt retirement

post_review_permission_ack_and_control_c.permission_amplification: overlay NONE now requires requested and effective permission modes to be identical in the immutable primitive, ROOT turns, and queued NEW_TURN rows; named PostgreSQL CHECK constraints reject read-only to bypass mutations
post_review_permission_ack_and_control_c.query_first_writer_replacement: Plan question and draft resolution first perform stateless exact winner confirmation; only a NONE result binds the current Host writer generation, so an old physical attempt can query a FULL semantic winner after writer replacement
post_review_permission_ack_and_control_c.plan_batch_exact_confirmation: assistant block identity and arguments, every tool result row and canonical entry, workflow or interaction state, continuation turn and revision, origin turn terminal state, and every expected committed occurrence are exact-joined before returning FULL
post_review_permission_ack_and_control_c.force_exit_control_projection: current-control handoff projection uses the same CANCELLED or ABORTED interaction mapping as the canonical handoff claim, preserving the exact interaction identity for FORCE_EXITED_PLAN
